selection_rule: One explicitly supported development task, P29_04_CODE, selected for a mechanism-use check after all twelve P37 record probes. Not an independent effectiveness or generalization evaluation. Other tasks and heldout scenarios are not claimed as covered.
order_rule: Run none_keep, exact_keep, contract_keep once each; do not replace failed branches or extend budgets.
interface_rule: All arms see identical full retained history and the same read_fields guide. The model chooses requested fields. Raw call_api is unchanged; exact caches in both cache arms can reuse whole show_song replies, including raw calls.
contract_rule: P37 pinned Song library-to-detail public fields; six audited read handlers preserve the within-run revision, all other sent operations invalidate, errors never become successful cache entries.
budget_rule: Same original 80 API cap including prefix, 16 continuation calls, 120000 logical input+output tokens, 480 seconds. Cache hits are recorded but do not count as backend sends; helper, index and lookup wall cost belong to continuation. Experimental restoration is separately reported. No condition gets a free model call.
continuation_gate: Mechanism check only: inspect all three final outcomes, interface use, exact/cross-API hits, backend sends and total tokens. No hits means implementation is not evidence of benefit. A hit without successful completion or lower total cost does not establish quality-preserving efficiency. Even a favorable one-task result does not establish novelty or noninferiority.
